blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean squared error by 47\%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Computational fluid dynamics is central to aerodynamic design. Solving Reynolds-averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) equations for steady turbulent flows [ 1 ] on a discretisation of the domain allows engineers to evaluate a candidate geometry’s pressure, velocity and turbulence fields. Evaluating many candidates this way is computationally expensive, which limits how many a design loop can explore [ 2 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 计算流体动力学是空气动力学设计的核心. 解决Reynolds-Perental Navier-Stokes(RANS)在域上平稳动荡流的方程[1]使工程师能够评价候选几何的压力、速度和动荡场。 以这种方式评价许多候选人是计算昂贵的,这限制了一个设计环可以探索多少[2,3].

blocks.en: Deep learning has recently emerged as a surrogate [ 4 ] , where a learned model replaces the solution with a direct map from the geometry, the boundary data and the flow parameters to the solution fields, computed in one forward pass and orders of magnitude faster at inference. Physics-informed networks encode the governing equations in the training objective, so the output satisfies the PDE residual and the boundary conditions [ 5 , 6 ] . This approach requires an explicit closure model, which is restrictive for industrial RANS turbulence. Neural operators instead learn the input-output map from simulation data to achieve discretisation invariance [ 7 , 8 ] . The Fourier neural operator [ 9 ] approximates the kernel by a pointwise multiplication in the Fourier domain, and extensions to irregular domains use message passing [ 10 ] . Mesh deformation [ 11 ] , or message passing directly on the mesh [ 12 ] , local kernels approximate the global coupling of elliptic problems poorly, and Fourier bases lose accuracy on complex geometries. Transformer solvers address this coupling directly, at the cost of a quadratic attention complexity [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . Among these, Transolver [ 17 ] assigns mesh points to physics slices and attends among the resulting tokens, decoupling cost from mesh size. These architectures share a common trait, in that information is mixed through a single mechanism.
blocks.zh: 深度学习最近以代词[4]出现,其中被学习到的模型用从几何学,边界数据和流参数到解域的直接地图来取而代之,用一个前传来计算,在推论中,数量顺序更快. 物理信息网络在训练目标中编码了管理方程式,因此输出满足了PDE剩余和边界条件[5,6]. 这种办法需要一种明确的封闭模式,这种模式对工业的RANS动荡具有限制性。 神经操作员则从模拟数据中学习出输入-输出映射,以达到盘式变异[7,8]. Fourier神经操作员[9]在Fourier域中以指针相乘来取近于内核,对不规则域的扩展使用消息通过[10]. Mesh变形 [11],或直接传递到 mesh [12]上的消息,局部内核大致上椭圆问题的全球耦合性差,而Fourier Bases在复杂的地美图上失去了准确性. 变形器解析器直接处理这种耦合,代价是四倍注意力的复杂性[13,14,15,16]. 其中,Transolver [17] 将网点指定为物理切片,并在产生的符号中出席,将成本与网点大小脱钩. 这些架构有一个共同的特点,即信息通过单一机制混合。

blocks.en: A separate line of work grounds the architecture in the discrete differential operators of the mesh, using discrete exterior calculus [ 18 ] . In HodgeNet [ 19 ] , hodge stars are learned as diagonal matrices and in DiffusionNet as learned diffusion times [ 20 ] . HodgeFormer [ 21 ] proposes attention-parametrised stars on all three cochain degrees. In all of these constructions, the learned operator lies on the prediction path, computing the field directly. Since a discrete Hodge Laplacian L 0 = ⋆ 0 − 1 d 0 ⊤ ⋆ 1 d 0 L_{0}=\star_{0}^{-1}d_{0}^{\!\top}\star_{1}d_{0} is a Dirichlet-energy operator, a layer built on it smooths the field it predicts.

blocks.en: Sparsely gated mixtures of experts are normally used to scale capacity at roughly constant compute, with a router implemented as a linear probe on the token embedding, under which the specialisation the experts acquire is not fixed by the construction [ 22 , 23 ] . Geometry-gated mixtures of experts for multi-scale PDE problems are available in the literature. GNOT [ 15 ] gates a mixture of experts with a network that takes query coordinates as input, and GAOT [ 24 ] combines a ladder of scale-specific branches with a learned per-point softmax gate. We adopt this pattern and use a Hodge-Laplacian controller, and propose a mixture of plain transformer experts, each biased towards one spectral scale. To bind each expert to a scale, we supervise it with a second, diagonal-star Hodge Laplacian applied to the training target, which decomposes the target into a sequence of components

blocks.en: The contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows: (i) We discuss a Gaussian star construction ( section 3.5.1 ) that is symmetric positive definite whenever its neighbour support is mutual, and under which the assembled operator then has a real non-negative spectrum; the supports used here do not meet that condition ( section 3.2 ). (ii) We propose an architecture that removes the learned discrete Hodge Laplacian from the prediction path and uses it only to compute routing weights. (iii) We introduce a supervision scheme in which a second, diagonal-star Hodge Laplacian that decomposes the target into a sequence of components ( section 3.7 ). (iii) We evaluate the approach on the official AirFRANS split against a Transolver baseline, trained natively on the same working mesh with identical data, loss and metric code ( section 4.2 ). Section S1 lists every symbol used below, with its type and its meaning. The remainder of this paper is organized as follows: section 2 reviews related work, section 3 presents the method, section 4 describes the simulation setup and reports the results, and section 5 discusses the lift gap and the limits of the comparison.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: The reported model uses a vertex-only Hodge controller. The description below presents the VEF extension, which additionally updates edge and face streams; their comparison is reported in table S6 .
blocks.zh: 被报道的模型使用一个只有顶点的Hodge控制器. 以下描述介绍了VEF扩展,该扩展还刷新了边缘和面相流;表S6报告了它们的比较.

blocks.en: The prediction path consists of a shared vertex embedding, a Hodge controller, transformer experts, and a field decoder. The controller produces routing weights from vertex, edge, and face features together with the mesh incidence matrices and neighborhood indices. Each expert combines the shared embedding with fixed Fourier positional features and produces both a latent representation and an auxiliary band prediction. The routing weights combine the latent representations, which the decoder maps to the four output fields. During training, a separate diagonal-star vertex Laplacian smooths the reference fields to construct telescoping atoms. A learned assignment combines these atoms into expert-specific supervision targets. This analyzer is absent from inference, and its conductances receive no objective gradients because the atoms are detached before assignment.
blocks.zh: 预测路径由共享顶点嵌入,Hodge控制器,变压器专家,和场解码器等组成. 控制器会从顶点,边缘,和面部特征以及网点事件矩阵和相邻指数中产生路由权重. 每位专家将共享嵌入与固定的傅里叶位置特征相结合,并产生潜在代表和辅助波段预测. 路由权重结合了潜在的表示法,解码器将它映射到四个输出字段. 在训练期间,一个单独的对角-恒星顶点Laplacian平滑了参考场来构造远程扫描原子. 一项学习到的任务将这些原子结合成专家特有的监督目标. 这个分析器在推论中是没有的,它的导出没有获得客观的梯度,因为原子在分配前是被分解出.

blocks.en: The controller uses two Hodge-former neural blocks operating on vertices, edges, and faces. Their implementation is called the PSD-Hodge layer , reflecting the intended positive-semidefinite (PSD) construction. The spectral guarantees depend on symmetry of the effective neighborhoods and compatibility of the star operators, as discussed in sections 3.5.1 and 3.5.2 .
blocks.zh: 控制器使用两个Hodge-前神经区块在顶点,边缘和面部上运行. 其实施被称为私营部门司-霍奇层,反映了计划中的正-半成型结构。 如3.5.1和3.5.2节所讨论,光谱保证取决于有效相邻的对称性和恒星操作者的相容性。

blocks.en: AirFRANS [ 1 ] provides node positions, input features, and four solution fields. blocks.en: The nine vertex inputs are defined in section 3.3 . They encode geometry, inlet velocity, signed distance, supplied normals, and wall membership. blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We propose a Hodge-routed mixture of transformer experts for steady-PDE prediction on unstructured meshes. A learned Hodge Laplacian computes the routing weights, and a separate analyzer constructs multiscale supervision targets. On the AirFRANS working mesh, mean relative L 2 L_{2} and interior mean squared errors decrease by 31 % 31\% and 47 % 47\% relative to Transolver, from 0.0436 0.0436 to 0.0300 0.0300 and from 0.00265 0.00265 to 0.00140 0.00140 , respectively. The largest per-field improvement is in turbulent viscosity, whose relative L 2 L_{2} error decreases by approximately 46 % 46\% , from 0.1158 0.1158 to 0.0629 0.0629 ( table S7 ). Introducing the Hodge controller into the learned-band mixture reduces mean relative L 2 L_{2} error from 0.0345 0.0345 to 0.0300 0.0300 ( table S6 ), with larger additional gains in velocity and pressure than in turbulent viscosity ( table S7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个Hodge路由式的变压器专家混合物,用于对无结构的中间体进行稳定的PDE预测. 一个博学的Hodge Laplacian计算出路由权重,一个单独的分析器构建出多尺度的监理目标. 在AirFRANS工作网点上,平均相对L 2 L_{2}和内部平均平方差差数分别比特兰索弗减少31% 31\%和47% 47\%,分别从0.0436 0.0436到0.0300 0.0300和从0.0265 0.00265到0.00140 0.00140. 每地最大的改进是在波动粘度上,其相对的L 2 L_{2}误差从0.1158 0.1158降至0.0629 0.0629(表S7)。 将Hodge控制器引入学习波段混合物,将平均相对L 2 L_{2}误差从0.0345 0.0345降至0.0300 0.0300(表S6),在速度和压力方面的增益大于波动粘度(表S7)。

blocks.en: The mean relative L 2 L_{2} error for pressure is lower than Transolver’s, while surface and relative lift-coefficient errors are higher: 0.00164 0.00164 versus 0.00143 0.00143 and 0.0225 0.0225 versus 0.0103 0.0103 , respectively ( table 1 ). Both models retain lift rank correlations above 0.9998 0.9998 , preserving case ordering more accurately than force magnitudes. Pressure errors along the airfoil contour therefore require further examination.
blocks.zh: 平均相对L 2 L_{2}的压力误差低于Transolver的误差,而地表和相对升降系数误差则更高: 0.00164 0.00164 与 0.00143 0.00143 和 0.0225 0.0203 相比(表1)。 两种型号都保留了起重级相比为0.9998 0.9998以上,保留了大小写顺序比起力能级更准确. 因此需要进一步检查气相轮廓上的压力误差。

blocks.en: We follow Transolver’s evaluation format on the official AirFRANS 800 / 200 800/200 split, with one training run per configuration and evaluation on a remeshed working mesh of approximately 4.9 4.9 K vertices. The results do not establish accuracy at the original CFD resolution or robustness across random seeds. The analyzer’s algebraic target reconstruction holds independently of the controller’s conditional spectral guarantee. The implementation does not enforce the reciprocal neighborhoods required by that guarantee, and prediction accuracy does not validate it. Every expert is evaluated, and dense attention scales quadratically with mesh size. Future work should enforce the controller’s structural conditions and evaluate efficient expert architectures across mesh resolutions and PDE families.
blocks.zh: 我们在正式的AirFRANS 800 / 200 800/200拆分上遵循Transolver的评价格式,每个配置进行一次培训,对大约4.9K个顶点的重修工作网进行评价。 结果不能确定原始CFD分辨率的准确性或横跨随机种子的稳健性. 分析器的代数目标重建独立于控制器的条件光谱保证。 实施并不强制实施该保障所要求的对等邻里,预测准确性也无法验证. 每一个专家都得到评价,密集的注意力以网状尺寸为四倍。 未来的工作应强化控制员的结构条件,并评估网络分辨率和PDE家族的高效专家结构。
